messages:
marco: FYI I'm opening a small PR to clarify the billing export example and add a one-line onboarding dashboard link. Need a quick sanity check on payload fields and the migration note for legacy burst credits.

tara: Drop the snippets here pls. I'll check field names vs. the export pipeline.

marco: JS example for per-request tier selection (compact):

marco: ```js
// choose-tier.js
const res = await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {
    'Authorization': 'Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY',
    'X-Redwood-Tier': 'team-premium',    // preferred tier (case-insensitive)
    'X-Redwood-Fallback': 'cost-optimized'
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({model:'redwood-13b', input:'Summarize the migration steps'})
});
console.log(await res.json());
```

henry: Nice. Add a tiny curl snippet too (customers paste that directly). Also remind that some SDKs accept underscores in header names.

marco: Curl one-liner added: 

marco: ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Tier: team-premium" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Fallback: cost-optimized" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-13b","input":"Summarize the migration steps"}'
```

tara: For analytics: show the new schema and an example row customers will get in CSV/JSON export. Call out rename from "tier_label" -> "usage_tier" and how legacy burst credits appear.

marco: Export example (JSON):

marco: ```json
{
  "export_rows": [
    {"meter":"tokens","usage_tier":"team-premium","value":15000,"timestamp":"2026-02-10T12:00:00Z"},
    {"meter":"requests","usage_tier":"team-premium","value":120,"timestamp":"2026-02-10T12:00:00Z"},
    {"meter":"burst_credits","usage_tier":"legacy-grant","value":40,"timestamp":"2026-02-10T12:00:00Z"}
  ]
}
```

henry: Important: legacy burst credits show up as a transient object in the quota API called "graceAllowance" and as meter rows with usage_tier "legacy-grant" in exports. Add a troubleshooting bullet: if customers see "tier_label" in their export, they likely need to update to the 2026-01 billing schema or contact finance.

marco: Will add. Also adding the templated console panel link PM wanted for onboarding emails: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboard/billing_export_panel?org={{org_id}}. Note: requires console:billing-read role.

billing-bot: FYI billing change log: field rename happened on 2026-01-05. If exports include old fields, mapping warnings are emitted.

tara: Can we include a short CLI command to let customers dry-run quota consolidation so they can see how legacy burst credits will be handled?

marco: Sure — adding the CLI snippet: 

marco: ```bash
# dry-run consolidation of legacy burst credits
redwood-cli quotas migrate --org $ORG_ID --dry-run
```

henry: Editorial nit: avoid the word "slab" in new docs. Use "legacy-grant" or "legacy-slab" only in historical notes. Also add a one-line example of a CSV row for BI teams.

marco: CSV sample row added to the doc: 

marco: tokens,team-premium,15000,2026-02-10T12:00:00Z

docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5342 7 reviewers: @tara @henry

tara: I'll review tonight and check the analytics reference page to ensure the field names match the export schema. If finance flags anything I'll coordinate in the PR.

marco: Thanks all 44d I'll push fixes if CI/linter complains and ping when merged.
